ROUND 4 UPDATE: fixes refuter's D1 blocker found in round 3 (round 2's M6 db.session.rollback() undid flushed rows but left created/updated/skipped counters and id_map unreset, so a mid-batch element-flush failure could report a false non-zero created count for a row that no longer exists, or feed a phantom FK id into the relationship pass). Fix: on any element-flush exception, after rollback() also reset created=updated=skipped=0 and id_map.clear(), set element_batch_failed=True, append an error stating the whole batch was discarded, and break the element loop; immediately after the loop, if element_batch_failed short-circuit-return zeros for every count and an empty relationships_failed, so the relationship pass (which reads id_map) never runs against a partially-invalidated batch. New regression test tests/test_archimate_import_service.py::test_element_flush_failure_discards_whole_batch reproduces refuter's exact [A, BAD, C] repro via a monkeypatched db.session.flush that raises on the second call, and asserts both the zeroed response AND that none of A/BAD/C exist in the DB afterward (the assertion that actually catches D1 -- pre-fix, A would have been left falsely reported as created).
